description_zh: 每题跨重复均值的 GPU、CPU gross 能耗分布；两面板纵轴分别缩放。
description_en: GPU and CPU gross-energy distributions of question means; panels use separate vertical scales.

description_zh: 每题五次单调计时延迟均值分布，毫秒除以1000换成秒，包含整个 query。
description_en: Distribution of five-repeat question latency means, converted from milliseconds to seconds; full query window.

description_zh: 各策略五次运行均值；横向小位移对应 repetition 1至5，三角形标明能耗分母199。
description_en: Five run means per strategy; horizontal offsets identify repetitions 1 to 5; a triangle marks energy denominator 199.

description_zh: 多数正确性、五次运行准确率和平均运行准确率分别显示；无推断性区间。
description_en: Majority correctness, five individual run accuracies and mean run accuracy are displayed separately, without inferential intervals.

description_zh: 以200道题等权能耗均值及多数正确率描述权衡；不作显著性或统计支配解释。
description_en: Descriptive tradeoff between equal-weight mean question energy and majority accuracy over 200 questions; no significance or statistical dominance interpretation.

description_zh: 最终答案模型比例，分母为每策略1000次逐题执行；不表示1000道独立题目。
description_en: Final-answer model shares among 1000 query executions per strategy, not 1000 independent questions.

description_zh: 最终输出截断率与答案提取失败率；分母为1000次逐题执行，两类标记可能重合。
description_en: Final-output truncation and extraction-failure rates among 1000 query executions per strategy; flags may overlap.

description_zh: 每题均值上的积分方法差：绝对差|左保持-梯形|与相对差百分数；不代表传感器精度或正式效应量。
description_en: Question-mean integration differences: absolute |left hold - trapezoid| and signed relative percent; not sensor accuracy or a formal effect size.
